correctness.rationale: On simple undirected C_n, n≥3 and m≥3 common labeled actions with at least one rebel, direct best-response comparison gives rebels two unequal incident edges and conformists at least one equal edge. Therefore a conformist run of length 1 precludes equilibrium; runs length≥2 have first/last equal edges and nonadjacent excluded interior equal edges. Counting those independent interior choices gives F_l(z), exponent B counts unequal edges; contraction of equal-edge paths yields the proper cyclic block coloring count (m−1)^t+(−1)^t(m−1), including the two-block boundary. Summing proves the displayed product, the unequal-edge distribution, and order invariance without extrapolating from finite tests. An independent full payoff-search enumeration matched 169 small mixed-type words.
residual_risks: Finite direct-payoff enumeration is corroboration only; theorem assumes m≥3 and no stubborn/weighted/directed edges.
